adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained offset beginning near index 479 (sharp drop in N from ~-6 to ~-23, E from ~2–3 to ~15–17, U from ~0 to ~-12–-14) and persisting through ~518, followed by a return to pre-offset levels by ~526. P1 (476–518) captures onset well but ends before full return; P2 (479–526) better aligns with both onset and return boundaries. Interior observations (e.g., indices 480–515) are stable at offset level, supporting a genuine temporary platform. Missing samples at 505 and 516 do not disrupt the coherent offset-return pattern. Numerical tool best fit (479–527) corroborates P2’s span. Thus, P2 is the genuine temporary platform; P1 is subsumed/overlapping and should be replaced.
